items:
Home Highlights
-Private Resort Style Pool - (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1)
- Complimentary beach service setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31)
-Large Rooftop Deck with Gulf Views
-Game Room
– Approximately 250 Steps to Beach
-Elevator
-Six Seater Golf Cart
-Six Adult Bikes

Beautifully nestled among the timeless oaks and stately magnolias of Old Seagrove, Drift Away 30A is an exquisite, newly constructed beach retreat offering the pinnacle of luxury coastal living. As the sun's golden rays dance on the turquoise waves just 250 steps away, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of opulence and tranquility. Features of this home include 8 bedrooms, 8.5 bathrooms, a private resort style pool, outdoor kitchen, dining and bar space, roof top deck with Gulf views, a game room, and elevator. Clever design pleases as you step into the first level family entertainment space with a large game room. Guests will enjoy a private retreat in the King bedroom with bath and shower, or the fun companionship in three Queen-over-Queen Bunks with shared shower.

The second level boasts an open concept living area seamlessly blending timeless elegance with modern comfort. Relax on plush furnishings handcrafted for indulgence or gather around the fireplace as the gentle sea breeze whispers through. The gourmet kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, featuring top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, a spacious marble-topped island, and custom cabinetry that exudes sophistication. Whether you're a culinary enthusiast or prefer the services of a private chef, this kitchen and dining spaces are poised to delight. Step outside onto the expansive terrace and let your senses be captivated as you overlook the crystal waters of the resort style pool and jacuzzi below, creating a visual masterpiece that is equally enchanting day and night. Unwind in the lavish primary suite, where a king-sized bed invites you to sink into its embrace. The ensuite bathroom is a spa-like haven, boasting a deep soaking tub, a rainforest shower, and pristine dual vanities. Additional guest space unfolds in Twin-over-Twin bunks.

The third level thoughtfully offers guests comfort and privacy with the choice of an additional Master suite with a private bath featuring its own shower and soaking tub, three King suites with private tub and shower ensuites, and a Two-twin bedroom with private bath featuring tub and shower. As the day draws to a close, savor a glass of champagne on your private rooftop deck, taking in the breathtaking sunset that paints the sky with hues of gold and pink. This luxury beach rental property is not just a residence; it is a symphony of elegance, comfort, and modern beauty. Experience the epitome of coastal living where every detail has been meticulously curated to provide an unparalleled escape for the discerning traveler.
